title: Clearer account creation
summary: When creating an account, tap ? beside Name or Username to see what each is for and which must be unique, and preview a sample profile with the names you typed.
changes: Creating an account has a ? beside Name and Username. Name is your display name and doesn't need to be unique; Username is how you sign in and how friends find you as @handle, so it must be unique. Both can be changed any time in Profile.
See a sample profile, under Create account, shows a profile card with the name and username you've typed, or Sam Sample until you type them, with example workouts, cardio and PRs.
